answer: Curing a proof takes 6 days, and a farm holding 588 proofs cannot cure them side by side. A single trial, a single mark: the trial is Lens grinder brass warrant mounted on the polishing lathe, the mark is each brass is a measured lens yield plus an optician's signature, and the panel accepts nothing else. A grove from a stranger, a sonnet from a ledger, a nadir from a nursery — three keepers who never met, telling one story. Walk the trail by hand: it is short enough to walk and long enough to trip a farm.
